data.name: Secondary-index primary-key order preservation
data.description: Secondary BTree equality scans can preserve row-id order from index key suffixes when ORDER BY targets the primary key.

data.scope: indexed equality ORDER BY primary DESC LIMIT

data.name: DESC ordered index probe limitation
data.description: Without a storage-level reverse prefix scan, DESC ordered secondary-index probes must scan the matching prefix before reversing and truncating; this is still useful for reducing row fetches but not full index scan work.
